label: Scene Template: Artifact + Editorial Split
description: WHOLE-SCENE template: a product ARTIFACT builds on one side while big serif editorial type and COUNTING stats own the other -- machine voice meets essay voice. The artifact slot takes a component spec ({type: 'slack-workspace'|'quotient-chat'|'quotient-social'|'quotient-app-shell'|'claude-code-session'|'claude-desktop'|'claude-cowork-home'|'claude-cowork-session'|'chat-simulator'|'ui-terminal-agent'|'ui-video-player'|'screencast-frame', data: {...}}) which is instantiated as a sibling and BUILDS on screen (typing, popping messages, advancing scrub bar). Prefer the REAL product mocks when the story happens there: slack-workspace for Slack moments, quotient-chat for conversations with the Quotient agent, claude-code-session (Claude Code in the TERMINAL: prompts, tool calls, diffs, working spinner) / claude-desktop (the Claude desktop app's Code tab: light theme, Recents sidebar, claude.ai-style pane) / claude-cowork-home (the desktop Home/Cowork screen: serif greeting + composer card) / claude-cowork-session (a RUNNING Cowork task: serif prose streaming beside the Progress/Outputs/Connectors rail) for Claude moments. Use for 'here is the surface where this step happens, and here is what it means' beats. Light editorial world by default.

headline.label: Editorial serif headline; '|' breaks lines (e.g. 'These days,|PRs from agents|are super long')

kicker.label: Small caps line above the headline

stats.label: Array of up to 4 {value, label}: numbers COUNT UP on entrance (e.g. {value: '629', label: 'files changed'})

artifact.label: The artifact that builds beside the editorial column: {type: component type, data: its slots}. Instantiated automatically as a sibling. Real product mocks (slack-workspace, quotient-chat, claude-code-session, claude-desktop, claude-cowork-home) are first choice when the beat happens in that product.

editorial_side.label: 'right' (default) | 'left' -- which side the editorial column takes

voice.label: 'brand' (default -- the brand kit display font carries the claims) | 'serif' (borrowed editorial serif voice)
